title: fix: prevent protocol error for unparented popups (#2827)
body:
This PR fixes a crash in Telegram (and potentially other clients) where creating a popup without a resolvable parent caused a Wayland protocol error. fix #2827 https://github.com/pop-os/cosmic-comp/issues/1816
    
    Change:
    - Modified src/wayland/handlers/xdg_shell/mod.rs to always configure and track popups, even if unconstrain_popup is skipped due to a missing parent.
    
    Fixes #2827
